This used to be a great practice. These days I dread contacting and feel like nobody cares anymore.

I’ve had to log several complaints in the last few years, regarding both process and attitude of staff.

Receptionists are rude, quick to presume, over talk you, not listen, have a “can’t do” attitude, fob you off and treat you like the enemy at the gates, even when they’re in the wrong. You have to fight to get looked after and the care you expect.

I dread to think what service less persistent patients than I would get.

I actually dread having to ring them and it makes me stressed and upset at the worst time (when ill) not feeling like a patient and more of a burden.

Avoid this practice at all costs unless you enjoy an argument and dealing with constant complaints with NHS England.

Sad to see how this has changed for the Cath the nurse and 2 other doctors are fine but for me this place is one big let down, especially when you struggling with an illness and need help!

UPDATE:
